description: The 32 compared solutions of education, each a part of the solution spending. Chain per solution: the share of the loss of education that the solution avoids if it is fully in place (reduction potential) times the probability that it is fully in place (fulfillment probability) gives the loss reduction; the loss reduction times the welfare loss share of education, the world htp and the education gain factor gives the potential gain in billion htp; the cost to set up the solution worldwide in billion USD times the person years per billion USD gives the initial effort in person years. Every reduction potential, probability and cost is assumed and has its own 80 percent probability range; where a study anchors a number, the description of the value names it. The inputs of the welfare loss share of education are repeated from problem_education.json, so that the gain can be calculated within this file, and the gain factor is the one of the start page solution spending. The table of the education solutions has its own columns, the solution, the loss reduction in percent, the potential gain in htp and the initial effort in person years, sorted by the biggest potential gain on top.

formulas.name: probability range low
formulas.description: the lower bound of the probability range of an estimate, the estimate multiplied by its low range factor; the centre is the stated target value and each bound is calculated on its own, so that a range can be asymmetric

formulas.name: probability range high
formulas.description: the upper bound of the probability range of an estimate, the estimate multiplied by its high range factor; the centre is the stated target value and each bound is calculated on its own, so that a range can be asymmetric

formulas.name: long run damage share of the GDP
formulas.description: the share of the world GDP that a problem costs at the end of its development, the share it costs today multiplied by the factor by which the damage still grows; the share is stated negative, because it is a loss

formulas.name: welfare damage share
formulas.description: the share of the global happy time points that a problem costs, the share of the GDP it costs multiplied by the factor by which the welfare damage exceeds the money damage, because htp counts the healthy life years that the GDP does not (concept paper introduction)

formulas.name: avoided welfare loss with a gain factor
formulas.description: the happy time points that a solution saves, like the avoided welfare loss, but multiplied by a factor of the problem, because the shared world htp is tuned to one problem and does not fit the others until the horizon of the ranking is stated; the result is stated positive, because it is a gain

formulas.name: loss reduction of a solution part
formulas.description: the share of the potential loss of a problem that one part of its solution avoids, the share of the loss it avoids if it is fully in place multiplied by the probability that it is fully in place; the same measure as the loss reduction of the whole solution in the start page ranking

formulas.name: initial effort of a solution part
formulas.description: the person years needed to set up one part of a solution, its cost in billion USD multiplied by the person years per billion USD
formulas.expression: "initial effort","person year" = "initial effort","billion","USD" * "person year per billion USD","factor"

values.description: the share of the world GDP that the learning poverty costs per year: the World Bank present value of the lifetime earnings lost by the current learning poor cohort, annualised over a working life of about 40 years; tuned so that the calculated loss matches the number that the start page has used until now

how many times bigger the long run loss is than the loss per year, because every learning poor cohort adds its lost earnings to the ones of the cohorts before; tuned so that the calculated long run share matches the number that the start page has used until now
how much the loss in happy time points differs from the loss in GDP; tuned so that the calculated share matches the number that the start page has used until now
the happy time points of the whole world over the horizon of the ranking as in problem_global_warming.json, where it is tuned to the global warming gain

the share of the world htp that the education gain uses, the factor of the start page solution spending in problem_education.json, so that the gain of every compared solution is calculated like the gain of the start page solution

the person years needed to set up a solution per billion USD of its cost, the 3 person years per 55 billion USD of the carbon border tariff of problem_global_warming.json, so that the effort of a education solution is comparable to the effort of a climate solution
